args.body:
Harbor State exposure: $95.5mm across Golf ($42.0mm), Hotel ($18.0mm), and Juliett ($35.5mm).

This month’s release shows 8 cited signals across your 3 held BDCs. Main changes were 4 markdowns, 2 maturity extensions, and 2 new/increased PIK signals.

FIXTURE GOLF CAPITAL CORP
Coverage: 2 paired holdings/signals in this release.
- Cedar Ridge Dental Partners LLC marked to 91.5 from 98.0, down 6.5 points (accession 0009000011-26-000111, row 102; prior row 502).
- Granite Peak Manufacturing LLC marked to 92.0 from 98.5, down 6.5 points (accession 0009000011-26-000111, row 106; prior row 506).

Read-through: Golf already sits on the watchlist for rising PIK share. This release adds two fair-value marks lower by 6.5 points each, which points to broader portfolio pressure in names beyond the existing PIK watch item.

FIXTURE HOTEL SENIOR LENDING
Coverage: 3 paired holdings/signals in this release.
- Pinecrest Learning Group Inc. maturity extended to 2031-09-30 from 2029-09-30, a 2-year extension (accession 0009000012-26-000121, row 105; prior row 505).
- Brightwater Fitness Holdings LLC marked to 93.5 from 99.0, down 5.5 points (accession 0009000012-26-000121, row 101; prior row 501).
- Oakmont Home Services LLC PIK increased to 3.0 from 1.0, up 2.0 points (accession 0009000012-26-000121, row 104; prior row 504).

Read-through: Hotel had one markdown, one extension, and one increased PIK signal in the same release. The combination is consistent with rising amendment activity and weaker cash-pay capacity in selected borrowers.

FIXTURE JULIETT LENDING BDC
Coverage: 3 paired holdings/signals in this release.
- Dunmore Insurance Brokers LLC maturity extended to 2030-03-15 from 2028-03-15, a 2-year extension (accession 0009000014-26-000141, row 104; prior row 504).
- Crestline Roofing Holdings LLC marked to 90.0 from 97.5, down 7.5 points (accession 0009000014-26-000141, row 103; prior row 503).
- Foxglove Specialty Pharma Inc. PIK increased to 2.5 from 0.0, up 2.5 points (accession 0009000014-26-000141, row 106; prior row 506).

Read-through: Juliett’s release also carried a mixed stress pattern: one material markdown, one extension, and one new PIK component.

Bottom line
- Golf: valuation pressure broadened, with two 6.5-point markdowns.
- Hotel: now shows the clearest clustered stress signal this month given concurrent markdown, extension, and PIK increase.
- Juliett: similar mixed stress indicators, led by a 7.5-point markdown.

I am separately preparing a Hotel watchlist entry backed by the cited filing rows for approval.

Best,
Jarvis
